subject: MAP weekly: integration action rotation & close timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Green <lucas.green@sierra-labs.com>; Sierra Labs Evaluation <eval@sierra-labs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: MAP weekly: integration action rotation & close timeline

Hi Lucas / Sierra team,

Following our MAP check-in today I wanted to circulate the week-one action rotation and owners so we have a single source of truth for close tasks. Goal is to keep track against the evaluation plan and aim for a feature-complete integration for the pilot by 2027-04-17.

Quick status snapshot (high-level):
- SDK integration: in-progress (blockers: token refresh flow tests)
- API auth: spec agreed, cert/key exchange pending
- Streaming & tool-calling: PoC working locally; cross-region streaming validation needed
- Evals: first prompt set drafted, running smoke-run tomorrow

Action items (owners & rough ETA):
1) Karthik: complete SDK token refresh tests and push patch to the test branch (ETA: 2027-04-05)
2) Marissa: coordinate streaming test window and provide instructions for end-to-end tool-calling flow (ETA: 2027-04-04)
3) Alex: prepare short runbook for cert/key exchange and sample curl commands for API auth (ETA: 2027-04-06)
4) Vanessa (me): consolidate evaluation prompt set, upload to Drive, and coordinate pilot readiness checklist (ETA: 2027-04-08)

Attachments: integration_spec_v1.pdf (API + SDK contract), streaming_test_plan.xlsx (test cases).

Can everyone confirm owners/ETAs or call them out in reply? Lucas — if your team wants a dedicated 30m slot for the streaming test, propose times and we'll lock it in.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP weekly: integration action rotation & close timeline

Thanks Vanessa — this looks good and clear. Two quick clarifications from our side: 

- Token refresh: will Karthik's patch include the client-side refresh flow or just server validation? We need both for our SDK leads to sign off.
- Streaming test: preferred window tomorrow between 10:30–12:00 PT. We also need a read-only service account for the test environment so we don't use any production keys.

We can provide a short list of sample payloads if that helps the streaming run. Otherwise confirming the pilot target of 2027-04-17 — we'll aim to be feature-complete and hand off for Redwood evals by 2027-04-12.

— Lucas
Senior Engineering Manager, Sierra Labs
lucas.green@sierra-labs.com

Thanks — quick update on my end:
- I'll include both client-side refresh flow and server-side validation in the patch and push to branch feature/sierra-token-refresh by EOD 2027-04-05.
- I added two tests to the streaming_test_plan.xlsx that exercise reconnect and token-rotation mid-stream.
- Note: we'll need the read-only service account details (key or short-lived token) from Lucas to run the mid-stream token rotation tests against their staging cluster.

Appreciate the quick responses team — closing the loop with final owner commitments and next steps: 

- Karthik: push token-refresh patch & tests by 2027-04-05 (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Marissa: run streaming test tomorrow 11:00 AM PT, upload logs + screencap (owner: marissa_cole).
- Alex: publish cert/key runbook and sample curl commands to Drive by 2027-04-06 (owner: alex_martinez).
- Vanessa: finalize prompt set + readiness checklist, schedule pilot handoff with Sierra for 2027-04-12 (owner: vanessa_ortiz).

I'll update the HubSpot deal (DEAL-8371-SIERRA) with these action items and the new close milestone (pilot complete -> internal eval -> production pilot). Relevant links: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/DEAL-8371 and Drive folder shared above.
